title: When will Europe's EV batteries come back? End-of-life volume estimates
text: We estimate that about 35,000 tonnes of end-of-life EV batteries reached EU recyclers in 2025, compared with roughly 120,000 tonnes of production scrap from cell manufacturing. End-of-life volumes should pass production scrap only after 2030, when cars sold in the 2020-2022 boom retire. Until then, recycling growth tracks gigafactory output more closely than EV retirements.
